lines.zh: 机械的声音在山谷间回荡
山谷回响着金属的声响
沉重的铁靴子踩在地面上
lines.en: Heavy iron boots on the ground

lines.zh: 紫光从它的骨缝里漏出
lines.en: Purple light leaks from its bone seams.
Each step crushes a slab of stone.

lines.zh: 铁靴在山道上碾出深痕
lines.en: Its iron boots grind deep tracks in the path.

lines.zh: 骨架嘎吱作响，却不停下
lines.en: Its frame creaks, but it never stops.

lines.zh: 目光空洞地注视着远方
lines.en: Empty gaze fixed on the distance

lines.zh: 铁制的盔甲反射着光线

lines.en: It stands its warhammer by its foot.

lines.zh: 紫光在它胸腔里缓缓转
lines.en: Purple light turns slowly inside its chest.

lines.zh: 它低头，像在听山的回声
lines.en: It lowers its head, as if listening to the mountain.
Vines push out between its armor plates.

lines.zh: 机械地转动着身体朝向玩家
它眼里的紫光亮了一度
lines.en: The purple in its eyes brightens a notch.
Its upper body turns to you; its feet do not.

lines.zh: 腐烂的魔力在体内涌动。
你散发出的光芒令我感到疑惑，但这肉看来不错。
lines.en: The light you emit confounds me, but that meat looks good.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之魂！我的晚餐终于出现了。
lines.en: Apalachia Soul! My dinner has finally arrived.

lines.zh: 别以为我吃素，这肉对我也是诱惑。
lines.en: Don't think I'm just a herbivore; this meat's an attraction too.

lines.zh: 你这外表虽然奇怪，但肉质可真香。
lines.en: Strange as you look, the meat's really tasty.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之魂，我想要它。
别跑，这肉可是难得一见的美味。
lines.en: Don't run, that meat is a rare delicacy.

lines.zh: 我需要更多强化魔法肉来增强自己。
lines.en: I need more enchanted meat to strengthen myself.

lines.zh: 紫光骨和粉光骨，我的晚餐更加美味。
lines.en: Purple bones and pink bones make for a better meal.

lines.zh: 我的盔甲需要强化，这肉正好。
lines.en: My armor needs strengthening, and that meat's perfect.

lines.zh: 你身上的装备看起来很吸引人。
lines.en: The gear on you looks really tempting.

lines.zh: 我用盾牌挡住了你的攻击。
lines.en: I blocked your attack with my shield.

lines.zh: 我不会轻易被你的攻击击败。
lines.en: I won't be easily defeated by your attacks.
Your strength isn't enough to defeat me.

lines.zh: 我用我的手杖抵御了你的撞击。
lines.en: I repelled your impact with my staff.

lines.zh: 我不怕你的攻击，它们对我无效。
lines.en: I'm not afraid of your attacks; they're ineffective against me.

lines.zh: 你撞不倒我，我的盔甲太坚固了。
lines.en: You can't knock me down; my armor is too strong.

lines.zh: 你的撞击无法伤害我，我已经强化了。
lines.en: Your impact can't hurt me; I'm reinforced.

lines.zh: 我用咒语抵御了你的撞击。
lines.en: I repelled your impact with a spell.

lines.zh: 你的撞击对我毫无作用。
lines.en: Your impact has no effect on me.

lines.zh: 找对象可不容易，但遇到你了。
lines.en: Finding a mate isn't easy, but I've found one.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之魂，我的伴侣。
和你在一起，我会变得更强大。
你的外表和力量都吸引着我。
lines.en: Your appearance and strength attract me.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚之魂，跟我走吧。
你似乎很适合做我的伴侣。
lines.en: You seem perfect as my mate.

lines.zh: 和你在一起，我会更加强大。
lines.en: With you, I'll be even stronger.

lines.zh: 你的力量和美丽让我心动。
lines.en: Your strength and beauty have drawn me in.

lines.zh: 让我们一起守护这片土地。
我把最强的一块骨种推给你。
lines.en: I push my finest bone seed toward you.

lines.zh: 魔咒山脉傀儡盯着你，眼中闪烁紫光。
lines.en: Apalachia Golem locks eyes on you, glowing with purple light.

lines.zh: 它缓缓伸出手臂，准备抓住你。
lines.en: It slowly reaches out, ready to grab you.

lines.zh: 你从它掉落中找到了强化魔法肉。
lines.en: You find Enhanced Magic Meat from its drops.

lines.zh: 它的声音低沉，似乎在警告你。
它的盔甲因长时间战斗而显得破旧。
lines.en: Its armor, battered from long battles, gleams darkly.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛在黑暗中熠熠生辉。
lines.en: Its eyes glow in the dark.

lines.zh: 你从它掉落中找到了阿帕拉契亚之魂。
lines.en: You find an Appalachia Soul from its drops.

lines.zh: 它的声音中透露出一丝痛苦。
lines.en: Its voice carries a hint of pain.

lines.zh: 它缓缓地移动，似乎受了伤。
它掉落紫光骨种子和粉光骨种子。
lines.en: It drops Purple Bone Seeds and Pink Bone Seeds.
It reaches out, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛死死地盯着你。
它开始围绕你缓慢旋转。
你必须迅速反应，否则会被抓住。
lines.en: You must react quickly, or you'll be grabbed.

lines.zh: 它的身形仿佛由黑暗构成。
lines.en: Its form seems to be made of darkness.

lines.zh: 紫光在胸腔里转快了一圈。
lines.en: The purple light in my chest turns a notch faster.

lines.zh: 它似乎对你是敌是友犹豫不决。
lines.en: It seems unsure whether you are friend or foe.

lines.zh: 它的动作突然变得迅速。

lines.en: It begins to attack with its meat hammer.

lines.zh: 山道上的活物被它记下
lines.en: It has noted the living thing on its path.
It pulls its warhammer up out of the ground.

lines.zh: 它认定你是来偷种子的
lines.en: It decides you came for the seeds.
It takes its first step toward you.

lines.zh: 它似乎在寻找你的破绽。
lines.en: It seems to be searching for your weakness.

lines.zh: 它的力量在你身上爆发。
它的目标是你手中的物品。

lines.en: It tries to knock you down.
It brings the hammer up to shoulder height.
Purple light runs up the haft into the head.

lines.zh: 它堵住山道唯一的窄口
lines.en: It blocks the only narrow point of the path.
It does not dodge; it waits for your blow.

lines.zh: 战锤落地，山道塌了半边
lines.en: The hammer falls and half the path collapses.
A bone fist punches through your shield.
The hammer’s wind forces you to your knees.
Purple light wakes in a crack of the mountain.

lines.zh: 它从石中挣出，抖落碎石
lines.en: It tears out of the stone, shedding rubble.

lines.zh: 阿帕拉契亚的守卫醒了
山谷的回声聚成它的形状
lines.en: The valley’s echoes gather into its shape.

lines.zh: 紫光骨种子还揣在甲缝里。
lines.en: The purple bone seed is still in my armor's crack.
